user_query: I'm organizing a charity event and I need to buy some sports equipment. Can you search for 'basketballs' on Zappos and sort the results by best seller? It would be great if you could also provide the realtime product information for the first five basketballs in the list.

TaskList.description: Search for 'basketballs' on Zappos and retrieve the search results.
Sort the retrieved basketballs by best seller ranking.
Obtain real-time product information for the first five basketballs from the sorted list.
